sourceOccurrences.note: A first-contact argument on a compact avoiding arc uses lower semicontinuity of the lifetime, accessible-arc mapping, backward continuation away from the pole and Lindelof. Peano, Torhorst and Caratheodory then give full boundary extension; these classical theorems are named inputs.
